scope: Pure local business-rule prototype. Simulates one returned versioned state; no database write, actual atomic transaction, Camunda worker, authentication, payment check, messaging or customer-view synchronisation.

sources.section: F2 — Inventory and seasonal availability management
sources.qualification: Candidate scope and design proposals; not evidence of tutor approval.

formConfiguration.position: F2_Source Producer update branch -> F2_EnterStockChange -> F2_Producer. Order and seasonal branches do not wait for this task.
previewChecked: Current quantity 0 and version 7 are read-only
New quantity -1 is blocked by minimum 0
formConfiguration.dataBoundary: productId and update.source exist before load/source routing. On task activation, product.version is copied to local loadedVersion. Read-only display is separate from producerQuantity/producerStartDate/producerEndDate. Whitelisted outputs target update fields and expectedVersion=loadedVersion, never stored product.
formConfiguration.runtimeLimit: Form Preview does not execute task mappings, gateway conditions, service workers or database writes. Process-instance execution and trusted identity integration remain pending.

product.additionalProperties: Preserved by deep copy; no inventory update may change published or arbitrary metadata.

producerId.constraint: Nonblank, no surrounding whitespace; exact case-sensitive comparison only.

processedChangeIds.items: unique nonblank strings without surrounding whitespace

fields.producerId: Must equal stored producerId; self-reported consistency check, NOT authentication or authorization.
fields.quantity: Optional absolute nonnegative integer, excluding bool. Replaces stock; not a delta.
fields.startDate: Optional strict YYYY-MM-DD; omitted date is retained.
fields.endDate: Optional strict YYYY-MM-DD; omitted date is retained. Validate the resulting whole date range.

fields.confirmed: Exactly boolean true; upstream simulation assertion, not proof of payment or actual order confirmation.
fields.changeId: Nonblank string without surrounding whitespace; exact, case-sensitive key scoped to this product.
fields.deduction: Positive integer excluding bool, no greater than current stock for a new change.

season-check.effect: Retain quantity and sale dates; recompute available using explicit business_date.

businessDate.invalidInput: Raises ValueError, consistent with the F1 prototype; this is a caller/configuration error.

availabilityRule.expression: published is true AND quantity > 0 AND startDate <= businessDate <= endDate
availabilityRule.boundaryInclusivity: Both endpoints included; explicit design assumption from model documentation, not asserted as a tutor requirement.

fields.product: Independent deep copy, proposed new state only for applied; unchanged contents for other outcomes.
fields.errors: Array of {field, code, message}; empty for applied and duplicate.

outcomes.applied: Simulated update accepted. Compute available, increment version once, append changeId only for a new order.
outcomes.correction-required: Producer request validation or self-reported owner-ID consistency fails. Return original state.
outcomes.rejected: Unknown source, malformed update, unconfirmed/invalid/insufficient-stock order or disallowed fields. Return original state.
outcomes.duplicate: Valid order request has a previously processed changeId. Return existing state before checking stale expectedVersion; do not deduct or increment version.
outcomes.conflict: New valid change has a different expectedVersion. Return original state and require reload/review.
outcomes.invalid-product: Stored product shape, quantity, dates, tracking IDs or version is invalid; no silent repair.

prototypeAssumptions.statement: Stock uses whole discrete units. Fractional weights, unit conversion and numeric strings are unsupported; bool is never an integer quantity.
producerId and confirmed are self-reported simulation inputs. Equality/boolean checks provide no authentication, authorization, payment validation or order lookup.
expectedVersion is required for all three sources. Each accepted nonduplicate request increments version once, even if only a seasonal recomputation or a no-op producer update.

For a structurally valid order, processed changeId is checked before version conflict and current-stock sufficiency, so replay after a successful deduction returns duplicate. A real implementation must atomically verify version and uniqueness.
Deduplication stores IDs only, not payload hashes. Reuse of an ID with different positive deduction data returns duplicate; changed-payload detection and retention policy remain unimplemented.
Caller chooses business_date and its timezone policy. Inclusive date boundaries and the proposed season-check source are prototype policies, not a running schedule.

A confirmed-order input can deduct adequate stock regardless of the current published/seasonal flag; upstream order confirmation/checkout eligibility is outside this function. Available is recomputed afterwards.
Unknown source-specific fields are rejected. Producer updates cannot overwrite publication, version, processed IDs or available directly; extra product metadata is preserved.

notImplementedOrTested: Real concurrent requests, atomic database commits, uniqueness constraints, persistence failures or crash recovery.
Camunda workers, process-instance execution, BPMN expressions or Tasklist form completion. A separate Form Preview check has been completed and recorded above.
Customer-view synchronisation, queues, retry scheduling, seasonal timers, manual follow-up and operational monitoring.
Fractional stock, cross-product orders, change-ID payload fingerprints and deduplication retention limits.
